# Sensory Modality

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:SensoryModality`](gmeow-SensoryModality.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/SensoryModality>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/sensory-environment`](../../slices/sensory-environment.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The sensory channel or domain through which an environment property is measured or perceived — a value vocabulary (individuals, never subclasses). Distinguishes visual, auditory, olfactory, gustatory, tactile, thermal, air-quality, and other environmental sensing channels. A single environment or observation may span multiple modalities ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9): co-equal, non-functional).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:SensoryModality`](gmeow-SensoryModality.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
